references.title: SCIA Engineer Steel Code Check Theory 17.0

method.sufficient: normal + shear_penalty <= 1 and both transverse shear ratios <= 1
method.normal_capacities: Pure effective EN operators; whole physical line and exterior faces; first absolute yield; integer floors; minimum of signed branches.
method.strong_shear: One original web, hw=100-t; sw<=hw; no support-stiffener credit.
method.weak_shear: Two original flanges as rotated webs, each hw=50-t; own Table6.1 capacity; no lip/corner resistance credit.
method.continuous_bound: Seven explicit concurrent degree-two Bernstein fields. Controls are bounds, not physical witnesses.
method.separate_torsional_check: EN6.1.6 retains B, Tsv, Tw and transverse shear at the same wall/face/position. No T-to-V conversion or requirement T=0.

runtime_notes: Initial direct/network synthetic setup: 4.97 s and 2.93 s respectively; initial NBR attach including prototype hook: 0.51 s.
Expanded regression includes old, large fixtures: isolated area setup 170.02 s; all-three-member EN setups/calls 41.32–68.24 s. These are complete fixture times, not the incremental 6.27 cost.
Actual UI test journeys: 20.59–49.97 s each, including multiple render/export/import interactions. EN-on/NBR-off journey: 36.66 s. These are not single-click solver times.

integration.note: Combine with the independent EN6.1.3(3) original/corrected-stress policy in EN6.1.6. The maximum-absolute-moment rule in this 6.27 component does not replace that stress policy. Combined post-merge integration and current-cache epoch belong to the release validation.

limits: Sufficient conservative construction from Eq6.27, not a literal replacement equation printed in the standard. SCIA is implementation evidence, not a formal CEN interpretation.
Pinned own Ue100x50x17, ri=t, seven thicknesses 1.20–3.35 mm; nominal intact model; EN fyb=fya250 MPa, E210000 MPa, gammaM0=1.
An upper bound above 1 is inconclusive, never a physical failure witness.
The existing first-order model, action combinations, material E/G used for demand, and all three physical members remain unchanged. Existing NBR combinations are not renamed as integral EN design.
Member/network stability, second-order applicability, local force introduction, net rupture where applicable, connections and complete ELS remain separate. No global approval.
Outward intervals enclose the stored polynomial field; binary64 geometric shear capacities and the FE discretization are not certified as continuum/physical-model error bounds.
